create.name: Darius Bashar
create.bio:
Darius Bashar is a meditation teacher and creativity coach based in Toronto, Canada, and the founder of Artist Morning, a free online community where people meet on Zoom each week to meditate together and then write. He is also a portrait photographer whose pictures have appeared in TIME and on Oprah.com. For him, making things is a spiritual path, and most of what he teaches is about getting past perfectionism, self-doubt and the fear of being seen.

He has recorded more than 300 guided meditations on Insight Timer, many of them visualisations on courage, joy, self-belief, letting go and mortality, often written with writers and artists in mind. His seven-day Insight Timer course on creativity works with the inner child, the heart and the dreaming mind, and thousands of people have taken it. On YouTube he posts twenty-minute guided meditations and short talks, and his Substack sends out a weekly writing prompt, meditation and video workshop. For closer support he runs The Creative Sanctuary, a twelve-week one-to-one coaching programme of weekly calls, meditation, movement and creative assignments for people starting a book, a channel or another creative project.

courses.title: The Creative Sanctuary
courses.description: A twelve-week one-to-one coaching programme with a weekly 90-minute call, guided meditation, movement and creative exercises built around a personal plan. It suits people ready to launch a book, newsletter, channel or other creative project, and starts with a free discovery call.

courses.title: Supercharge Your Creativity
courses.description: A seven-day Insight Timer course of short lessons and practices for reconnecting with the urge to create. It visits the inner child, the wisdom of the heart and the inner dreamer, and closes with a mirror exercise.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Darius Bashar on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Hundreds of his guided meditations and visualisations on courage, joy, self-love and creative confidence, free to hear.

free_resources.title: Artist Morning weekly meditation and journaling group
free_resources.description: A free weekly hour on Zoom where the group meditates together and then does a short writing exercise. Members receive the link by email after joining.
